pages.text: Start your 5x ore chain. Mekanism is the T3-T4 tech mod: ore processing, gas handling, advanced machines and the road to the MekaSuit.

$(bold)T3 access:$() The basic Mekanism machines (Enrichment Chamber, Purification Chamber, Crusher, Chemical Injection) unlock at T3, and Osmium is the T3 base material.$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$() The full Mekanism processing chain yields up to 5 ingots per ore. Building it is a major T3 engineering project.

$(bold)T4 upgrade:$() The MekaTool, MekaSuit, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor and Antimatter production are T4 content, so T3 time is well spent planning your infrastructure for those upgrades.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() Efficient Engineering speeds up every Mekanism factory. A T3 Artificer has the fastest path to T4.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Mekanism is documented in JEI and on the $(bold)Mekanism wiki$() (mekanismmod.com). In game, hover any machine in JEI and press $(bold)R$() for its recipes or $(bold)U$() for its uses.$(br2)$(bold)Next: follow $(l:icraft:engineering/t3_five_x_chain)T3: The 5x Chain$(/l) machine by machine.$()
